title: Point-fibre transport of the pairing adjunction
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient parameters of a six-functor datum [def-sf-datum]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n,\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and let $F=\operatorname{Fib}_s$ be the point equivalence [lem-weil-point-fibre-equivalence]. Use the point derived tensor, internal Hom and unit $\Lambda_s$ of [def-sf-datum], completed at the integral stage and interpreted by scalar localization or a common finite stage at the field stages. Let
$$t_{P,Q}:F(P\otimes^L Q)\xrightarrow{\sim}FP\otimes^L_\Lambda FQ,\qquad u:F\Lambda_s\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda$$
be the coherent tensor and unit comparisons of [lem-sf-point-fibre-derived-tensor]. For any $P,Q\in D^b_{ctf}(s,\Lambda)$ and any point pairing $b:P\otimes^L Q\to\Lambda_s$, put $H=R\mathcal Hom_s(P,\Lambda_s)$ and let $\Phi:Q\to H$ be its tensor–internal-Hom adjoint, so $b=\operatorname{ev}_s\circ(1_P\otimes\Phi)$ with $\operatorname{ev}_s:P\otimes^LH\to\Lambda_s$ the evaluation. The canonical comparison
$$\alpha_P^1:FH\xrightarrow{\sim}R\operatorname{Hom}_\Lambda(FP,\Lambda)$$
is the evaluation-preserving comparison under the point equivalence: it satisfies
$$\operatorname{ev}_\Lambda\circ(1_{FP}\otimes\alpha_P^1)=u\circ F(\operatorname{ev}_s)\circ t_{P,H}^{-1},$$
where $\operatorname{ev}_\Lambda$ is coefficient evaluation. Then the coefficient pairing $\beta=u\circ F(b)\circ t_{P,Q}^{-1}:FP\otimes^L_\Lambda FQ\to\Lambda$ has tensor–internal-Hom adjoint
$$\beta^\sharp=\alpha_P^1\circ F(\Phi).$$

source.place: proof, second sentence: point tensor–Hom curry read under the coherent monoidal point equivalence, for an arbitrary point pairing

proof.text:
Expand the coefficient pairing using the point curry equation $b=\operatorname{ev}_s\circ(1_P\otimes\Phi)$ of the statement and functoriality of $F$: $F(b)=F(\operatorname{ev}_s)\circ F(1_P\otimes\Phi)$. Naturality of the tensor comparison of [lem-sf-point-fibre-derived-tensor] in its second variable, applied to $\Phi:Q\to H$ (both pairs $(P,Q)$ and $(P,H)$ are those at which the statement uses $t$), gives $t_{P,H}\circ F(1_P\otimes\Phi)=(1_{FP}\otimes F(\Phi))\circ t_{P,Q}$, hence
$$
\beta=u\circ F(\operatorname{ev}_s)\circ F(1_P\otimes\Phi)\circ t_{P,Q}^{-1}=\bigl(u\circ F(\operatorname{ev}_s)\circ t_{P,H}^{-1}\bigr)\circ(1_{FP}\otimes F(\Phi)).
$$
Insert the evaluation-preserving equation of the statement for $\alpha_P^1$, and use that $1_{FP}\otimes-$ preserves composition (the coefficient tensor is a bifunctor). The result is
$$
\beta=\operatorname{ev}_\Lambda\circ(1_{FP}\otimes\alpha_P^1)\circ(1_{FP}\otimes F(\Phi))=\operatorname{ev}_\Lambda\circ\bigl(1_{FP}\otimes(\alpha_P^1\circ F(\Phi))\bigr).
$$

source.place: proof, second sentence: point tensor–Hom curry read under the coherent monoidal point equivalence, for an arbitrary point pairing

proof.text:
Put $\psi=\alpha_P^1\circ F(\Phi):FQ\to R\operatorname{Hom}_\Lambda(FP,\Lambda)$. By the evaluation formula for uncurry in [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws], applied to the coefficient tensor–internal-Hom adjunction with $A=FP$, $X=FQ$, $Y=\Lambda$, the last display of Step 1 says $\operatorname{uncurry}(\psi)=(1_{FP}\otimes\psi);\operatorname{ev}_\Lambda=\beta$. By the cancellation clause of the same node, $\operatorname{uncurry}(\operatorname{curry}(\beta))=\beta=\operatorname{uncurry}(\psi)$; since $\operatorname{uncurry}$ is the inverse of the bijection $\operatorname{curry}$, it is injective, so the tensor–internal-Hom adjoint of $\beta$ is
$$
\beta^\sharp=\operatorname{curry}(\beta)=\alpha_P^1\circ F(\Phi),
$$
a map $FQ\to R\operatorname{Hom}_\Lambda(FP,\Lambda)$ in the asserted direction.
